$comment: Declarative AI Agent / Copilot tool definitions for the DLT observability module (Deliverable 6). OpenAI Assistants/Chat Completions function-calling JSON Schema shape -- the same 'name'/'description'/'parameters' triple maps directly onto a LangChain StructuredTool (name/description/args_schema) or a Semantic Kernel KernelFunction (name/description/parameters), so this one file is the single source of truth regardless of which agent framework loads it. Each tool is backed by a real, pure-Python function in NextGen_Metadata_Framework.lakeflow_framework.observability.agent_tools -- see 'implementation' below for the exact import path. See docs/25_dlt_observability_module.md for the Error Handling Matrix diagnose_pipeline_telemetry_failures mirrors, and docs/27_dlt_observability_onboarding_reference.md for the full attribute dictionary validate_observability_config enforces. IMPORTANT: there is no separate observability config file -- an onboarding spec's own 'observability': [...] array (validated by onboarding/spec_validator.py, upserted by onboarding/metadata_upsert.py::upsert_observability_config) is the only place this configuration lives; these tools help an agent author/validate that array before merging it into a pipeline's onboarding spec.

function.name: validate_observability_config
function.description: Lint and validate an {"observability": [...]} JSON or YAML fragment -- the same shape that goes inside a pipeline's onboarding spec, alongside ingestion_flows/transformation_flows -- against the allowed destination_type/protocol/compression/auth-type/credential-reference values and required fields. Call this BEFORE merging a generated or hand-authored fragment into an onboarding spec, or whenever a user pastes an observability config and asks 'is this valid?' / 'why is my destination not working?' (structural causes only -- for a failed task run's error message, use diagnose_pipeline_telemetry_failures instead).

config_text.description: Full fragment text, JSON or YAML: {"observability": [...]}. May contain unresolved {{catalog}}/{{env}} placeholders.

catalog.description: Value substituted for {{catalog}} before validation. Omit to leave any {{catalog}} placeholder as literal text (usually surfaces as a validation error, which is often what the caller wants to see).

errors.description: One entry per schema violation, formatted '<json_path>: <message>'.

function.name: generate_pipeline_onboarding_config
function.description: Auto-generate an {"observability": [...]} array to merge into a pipeline's onboarding spec, from a short list of destination targets (Databricks Volume and/or OTLP HTTP endpoints), filling in the full destination_config/auth/retry shape so the caller only supplies what's genuinely destination-specific. Call this when a user asks to 'set up observability for pipeline X' or 'onboard telemetry export to <destination>' -- the result should be passed through validate_observability_config, then merged into that pipeline's onboarding spec JSON/YAML (alongside its ingestion_flows/transformation_flows) before the next CREATE/UPDATE onboarding run.

dataflow_group_id.description: The target pipeline's dataflow_group_id -- informational only (used in a log line); the returned observability[] array carries no scoping of its own and simply takes on whatever dataflow_group_id the onboarding spec it gets merged into declares.

volume_path.description: Required for template=databricks_volume. Must start with /Volumes/.

endpoint.description: Required for template=otlp_http. Full https:// URL.

auth.description: Optional auth_config object (type + credentials, using env:/secret: references only).

resource_attributes.description: Optional per-destination OTel resource attribute overrides.

service_name.description: Fallback OTel service.name resource attribute merged into every otlp_http destination that doesn't already set one.

deployment_environment.description: Fallback OTel deployment.environment resource attribute, same merge rule as service_name.

observability.description: Merge this array directly into the target onboarding spec's own top-level "observability" key.

function.name: diagnose_pipeline_telemetry_failures
function.description: Inspect a failed observability task run's error message and match it against the known failure matrix (task wiring, pipeline config, destination config, credentials, destination outage, event log access) to return a likely cause and concrete remediation steps. Call this when a user pastes an error from a failed 'observability_export'-style task run and asks why it failed or how to fix it.

error_message.description: The exception message/traceback text from the failed task run (Jobs UI 'Error' panel, or a Jobs API run output field).

langchain_equivalent: Each 'function' object above maps to StructuredTool.from_function(name=..., description=..., func=<the implementation path>, args_schema=<a pydantic model built from 'parameters'>).
semantic_kernel_equivalent: Each 'function' object maps to a KernelFunction created via @kernel_function(name=..., description=...) decorating the same implementation, with 'parameters' properties becoming Annotated[...] argument types.
